_approach: Melodigging's Underground Amapiano: a darker, minimal strain built on a 'heavy, sliding log-drum bassline' - here the loudest, longest log-drum hits in the kit (tomLow+congaLow both at accent velocity), a hard, sparse kick and almost no top-end decoration. NOTE: tomLow+congaLow approximate the log drum's RHYTHM only - the real log drum is a tuned, pitch-bent kick/808/bass hybrid this drum-only library cannot reproduce; the melodic/bass part must come from a synth.
